authority: Defines staging manifest format, validation gates, and error codes. Used by validation scripts and agents writing to staging/.

staging_manifest_contract.description: Format for agent output files written to staging/
validation_gates: word_count_matches_actual: count words in primary field; must match declared word_count
entity_links_exist_in_db: verify each slug in persons/texts/concepts/locations
required_sections_present: verify structure for content type
staging_manifest_contract.checksum_field: SHA256 hash of primary content field (description, bio_html, analysis_html, or definition_long)
staging_manifest_contract.checksum_purpose: Detect accidental mutations between staging creation and database ingestion

WC_LOW.name: word_count_too_low
WC_LOW.message: Word count below minimum for this content type
WC_LOW.resolution: Expand content until word count requirement is met. Check SCHEMA.json for exact minimum.

WC_HIGH.name: word_count_too_high
WC_HIGH.message: Word count exceeds maximum for this content type
WC_HIGH.resolution: Condense content or split into two separate entries.

WC_MISMATCH.name: word_count_mismatch
WC_MISMATCH.message: Declared word_count does not match actual word count of primary field
WC_MISMATCH.resolution: Recount words and update word_count field.

MISSING_SEC.name: missing_required_section
MISSING_SEC.message: Required section not found in content
MISSING_SEC.resolution: Add the required <h2> section. Check STANDARD_*.md for section requirements.

SLUG_INVALID.name: invalid_entity_slug
SLUG_INVALID.message: Entity slug does not exist in database
SLUG_INVALID.resolution: Create the entity first, or verify slug spelling against database. Use lowercase-hyphen format.

ENUM_INVALID.name: invalid_enum_value
ENUM_INVALID.resolution: Use one of the valid enum values from SCHEMA.json. Do not invent new values.

BIB_INVALID.name: bibliography_format_invalid
BIB_INVALID.message: Bibliography does not match DGWE format
BIB_INVALID.resolution: Reformat per SCHEMA.json bibliography_format. Pattern: Last, First. Title. Publisher, Year.

CHECKSUM_FAIL.name: checksum_mismatch
CHECKSUM_FAIL.message: Primary content field has been modified since manifest was created
CHECKSUM_FAIL.resolution: Recalculate checksum: SHA256(primary_field_text) or verify intended change.

DUPLICATE_SLUG.name: duplicate_slug_in_manifest
DUPLICATE_SLUG.message: Same entity_slug appears more than once in manifest
DUPLICATE_SLUG.resolution: Remove duplicate entries. Each entity should appear once per manifest.

ACTOR_ANALYST_MISSING.name: actor_analyst_not_declared
ACTOR_ANALYST_MISSING.message: Concept definition does not explicitly declare ACTOR_TERM or ANALYST_TERM in opening paragraph
ACTOR_ANALYST_MISSING.resolution: Add explicit declaration: 'This is an ACTOR_TERM' or 'This is an ANALYST_TERM' in the opening paragraph.

NO_ENTITY_LINKS.name: insufficient_entity_links
NO_ENTITY_LINKS.message: Content has fewer than 3 [LINK:slug] entity links
NO_ENTITY_LINKS.resolution: Add [LINK:slug] markup for at least 3 persons, texts, or concepts mentioned in the content.

validation_pipeline.step_1: Agent writes staging file with correct format
validation_pipeline.step_5: Database CHECK constraints enforce final validation
